title: plantago coronopus subsp. cupanii
intro: Plantago coronopus subsp. cupanii, commonly known as Italian buckthorn or buckthorn, is a plant species within the Plantaginaceae family, specifically a subspecies of buckthorn. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and soothing digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and anti-diarrheal properties. The therapeutic actions of Plantago coronopus subsp. cupanii include astringent, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diarrheal actions, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and mucilages. The bioactive constituents of this plant contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
